name: redflag-mcp
description: An MCP server that provides queryable access to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) red flag knowledge from regulatory documents. It enables compliance officers to ask natural-language questions and receive relevant, sourced red flags from a local vector database.

rawRecord.description: An MCP server that provides queryable access to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) red flag knowledge from regulatory documents. It enables compliance officers to ask natural-language questions and receive relevant, sourced red flags from a local vector database.

MCP_HOST.description: Host address for the HTTP server when MCP_TRANSPORT is 'http'.

MCP_PORT.description: Port number for the HTTP server when MCP_TRANSPORT is 'http'.

MCP_TRANSPORT.description: Transport mode for the MCP server, e.g., 'stdio' or 'http'.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key, required for the extraction pipeline to send text to an OpenAI model.

OPENAI_EXTRACTION_MODEL.description: Override the default OpenAI model (gpt-4o-mini) used for extraction.
